info.name: Noyo Carrier Carrier Mapped Field Rule Set API
Retrieves a list of Rule Set Traces.

params.name: page_size
params.description: The max size of each page of results

params.name: offset
params.description: The integer offset at which to start the page. Possible values are 0 to total_records - 1

params.name: rule_set_ids
params.description: Comma separated UUIDs of rule sets to filter Rule Set Traces

params.name: group_id
params.description: Noyo specific group UUID to filter Rule Set Traces

params.name: employee_id
params.description: Noyo specific employee UUID to filter Rule Set Traces

params.name: member_snapshot_id
params.description: Noyo specific member snapshot UUID to filter Rule Set Traces

params.name: include_trace
params.description: Whether to include the trace in the response

items.docs: Returns a list of Rule Set Traces.

info.name: Get a single Rule Set Trace

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier of the rule set trace you would like to view

params.name: include_trace
params.description: Whether to include the trace in the response

items.docs: Returns a single Rule Set Trace based on the ID provided.

info.name: Retrieves a list of Rule Sets.

params.name: page_size
params.description: The max size of each page of results

params.name: offset
params.description: The integer offset at which to start the page. Possible values are 0 to total_records - 1

params.name: group_id
params.description: Noyo specific group UUID to filter Rule Sets

params.name: organization_id
params.description: Noyo specific organization UUID to filter Rule Sets

params.name: entry_point
params.description: Rule set Entry Point value to filter by

params.name: sandwich_position
params.description: Rule set metadata position to filter by

params.name: status
params.description: Rule set status to filter by

items.docs: Returns a list of Rule Sets.

params.name: rule_set_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the rule you would like to view

items.docs: Returns the latest version of a single rule set based on the ID provided.

params.name: rule_set_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the rule set to promote

params.name: rule_set_version
params.description: The version of the rule set to promote

items.docs: Promotes a rule set from draft or archived status to active status. Any existing active rule sets with matching type, entry point, and sandwich position will be archived.

params.name: rule_set_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the rule set you want to edit.

params.name: version
params.description: Unique version of the rule set you want to edit.

items.docs: Update a rule set based on the ID provided. The version parameter must match the latest rule set version.

params.name: rule_set_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the rule set you want to delete.

params.name: version
params.description: Unique version of the rule set you want to delete.

items.docs: Delete a rule set based on the ID provided. The version parameter must match the latest rule set version.
